label: Run the server test suite
description: Runs pytest in the server folder (SERVER_DIR). Needs the server requirements and pytest installed there.

label: Back up Firestore to a bucket
description: Exports the whole database to gs://BUCKET/backups/NAME. Run this before a migration. Needs gcloud signed in with access to the project.

label: Deploy the server to Railway
description: Uploads the server folder with the Railway CLI and waits for the build, then runs the live checks. Needs `railway login` and `railway link` done once in the server folder.

label: Deploy the landing page to Railway
description: Uploads the landing folder (Next.js) with the Railway CLI and waits for the build.

label: Build the web app
description: flutter build web --release in the repo. Run before deploying hosting.

label: Deploy the web app to Firebase Hosting
description: Publishes build/web. Users get the new version on their next load.

label: Deploy Firestore and Storage rules
description: Publishes firestore.rules and storage.rules. Rules apply within a minute.
